notes.title: Black Hole Void Update
notes.notes:
Update:


 The Timer in Time Mode has been improved
 The Timer score in Point Mode has been improved
 The Timer in Defense Mode has been improved
 The timer in DTB Mode has been improved


Dlc-Update:

 The timer has been improved in Survive The Hole

notes.title: Black Hole Void Update
notes.notes:
Update:

New Features:

 Added a high score animation.
 The high score is now highlighted in yellow when it is beaten.


Bug Fixes:

 Minor issues in Time & Point Mode have been resolved. Achieving a new, higher high score is now possible.

notes.title: Black Hole Void Small Update
notes.notes:
Update:


 City map One or two gaps in the ground have been closed


DLC Update:

 All items that can be collected through the Item Quest now have a yellow glowing arrow above them, making them easier to find and distinguishing them from food and drink.
